info.title: VulnForge API
info.description:
**VulnForge** — Automated Penetration Testing Framework.

All endpoints require authentication via JWT Bearer tokens unless explicitly marked as public.

Obtain tokens via `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

post.description: Create a new user account and immediately receive an access/refresh token pair. New accounts are assigned the **viewer** role by default. Email and username must be unique across the platform.

Exchange email + password for an access token (30 min) and refresh token (7 days). The same error is returned for wrong email AND wrong password to prevent enumeration. Accounts are locked after 5 consecutive failed attempts.

post.summary: Rotate refresh token and get new tokens
post.description: Present a valid refresh token to receive a new access + refresh token pair. The old refresh token is immediately revoked (token rotation). Presenting a revoked token indicates possible token theft.
Revoke the presented refresh token, invalidating this device's session.
Revoke all refresh tokens for the current user, logging out all devices.

get.description: Return the profile of the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Send a password reset link to the given email address. Always returns 200 regardless of whether the email exists (prevents email enumeration). Reset tokens expire after 15 minutes.
Apply a new password using the token received by email. On success, ALL active sessions are revoked — all devices must re-authenticate.
Change the current user's password. Requires the current password. All other active sessions are revoked on success.
Create a new workspace/engagement. The creating user is automatically assigned as the workspace **owner**. Requires at least the **analyst** platform role.

get.description: Return a paginated list of workspaces the current user can access. Platform admins and superusers see all workspaces. Use `include_archived=true` to include archived workspaces.
Retrieve full workspace details. Returns 404 if the workspace doesn't exist **or** the user has no membership (prevents existence disclosure).

patch.description: Partially update workspace metadata. Requires **OWNER** role in the workspace. Use the `DELETE /{id}` endpoint to archive the workspace — setting `status=archived` here is rejected.

delete.description: Soft-delete the workspace by archiving it. All data (scans, findings, reports) is preserved. Requires **OWNER** role. Use `POST /{id}/restore` to undo.

post.description: Restore a previously archived workspace back to **ACTIVE** status. Requires **OWNER** role or superuser.

get.description: Return aggregated engagement statistics for the workspace dashboard: scan counts by status, vulnerability counts by severity and triage status, member count, last scan timestamp, and a weighted risk score (0–100).
Return all members of the workspace including their per-workspace roles.

schema.title: Response List Workspace Members Api V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Members Get

post.summary: Add a member to the workspace
post.description: Add an existing platform user to this workspace with the specified role. Requires **OWNER** role in the workspace. The user must already have an active platform account.

patch.description: Change a workspace member's per-workspace role. Requires **OWNER** role. Cannot change the workspace owner's role.

delete.summary: Remove a member from the workspace
delete.description: Remove a user from the workspace. **Owners** can remove any member. **Members** can only remove themselves (leave the workspace). Cannot remove the workspace owner.

post.description:
Register a new scan target. The `value` field is strictly validated against `target_type`:

- **host**: Valid IPv4 or IPv6 address (not multicast, not unspecified)
- **network**: Valid CIDR notation (min /8 for IPv4, /16 for IPv6)
- **url**: HTTP/HTTPS URL with scheme and hostname
- **domain**: RFC 1123 hostname, subdomains, or wildcard `*.example.com`

Invalid values are **rejected at the API layer** — they never touch the database. Requires platform **analyst** role or higher.

get.description: Return a paginated, filterable list of targets. Supports filtering by type, tag, status, and workspace. Supports full-text search across name and value fields.

parameters.name: workspace_id

schema.description: Filter targets with scans in this workspace.
schema.title: Workspace Id

parameters.description: Filter targets with scans in this workspace.

get.description: Retrieve full target details including tags, scan count, and open vulnerability count.

patch.description: Partially update a target. Only the creator, admins, or superusers may edit. When updating `value`, `target_type` must also be provided (and vice versa) since value validity depends on type. The updated value is re-validated.

delete.description: Mark a target as inactive. Inactive targets cannot be used in new scans, but all historical scan data and findings are preserved. Use `POST /{id}/reactivate` to re-enable.

post.description: Re-enable a previously deactivated target, making it available for new scans.

put.description: Replace the entire tag set for a target (PUT semantics). All existing tags are removed and replaced with the provided list. Pass an empty list `[]` to clear all tags. Tags are validated and normalised to lowercase.

post.description: Add a single tag to the target. Idempotent — adding an already-existing tag returns 200 without error. Tags are normalised to lowercase. Maximum 20 tags per target.

delete.description: Remove a specific tag from the target. Returns 404 if the tag doesn't exist.

get.description: Return a summary of the workspace's scope configuration: count of active/inactive rules, allow vs. exclude breakdown, and per-type distribution. If `has_scope_defined` is False, no scans can be run against this workspace.
Return scope rules for the workspace. Optionally filter by disposition (allow/exclude) or rule type.

schema.title: Response List Scope Rules Api V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Scope Rules Get

post.description:
Add a new scope rule to the workspace. The `value` is validated against `rule_type` at the API layer. Requires workspace **OWNER** role.

**Rule Type Semantics:**
- **domain**: Exact FQDN match only — `example.com` does NOT match subdomains
- **subdomain**: Matches all subdomains — `example.com` matches `api.example.com`
- **cidr**: IPv4/IPv6 network range — `10.0.0.0/24` matches all hosts in that range
- **wildcard**: Glob pattern — `*.dev.example.com` matches one level of subdomains
- **host**: Single IP exact match — `192.168.1.100`

**Disposition:**
- **allow**: Target matching this rule is in scope
- **exclude**: Target matching this rule is out of scope (exclude overrides allow)

Import multiple scope rules in a single request (max 100). Duplicate rules (same type+disposition+value) are silently skipped. Set `replace_existing=true` to clear all existing rules first. Requires workspace **OWNER** role.

schema.title: Response Bulk Import Scope Rules Api V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Scope Rules Import Post

patch.description: Update a scope rule's description, active status, or disposition. The `value` and `rule_type` cannot be changed — delete and recreate for that. Requires workspace **OWNER** role.

delete.description: Permanently delete a scope rule. Use PATCH with `is_active=false` to temporarily disable without deleting. Requires workspace **OWNER** role.

post.summary: Check if a target is in scope
post.description:
Test whether a target value would be permitted by the workspace's scope rules. This is the same check that runs before every scan. Use this to validate your scope configuration interactively.

**Verdicts:**
- **permitted**: Target matches an ALLOW rule and no EXCLUDE rule
- **denied**: Target matches an EXCLUDE rule, or no ALLOW rule matches
- **no_scope_defined**: No active rules exist — all scans are blocked

This endpoint does NOT trigger a scan.

get.description: Return paginated scan profiles. By default includes builtin profiles and platform-wide custom profiles. Filter by workspace to include workspace-scoped profiles. Builtin profiles are listed first, then custom profiles alphabetically.

post.description: Create a new custom scan profile. Optionally specify an initial plugin set with per-plugin config overrides. For standard configurations, prefer **cloning** a builtin profile. Requires platform **Analyst** role or higher.

get.description: Return full profile details including all plugin entries with their enable state, execution order, and config overrides.

patch.description: Partially update a custom profile's name, description, scan type, priority, timeout, tags, or active state. **Builtin profiles cannot be updated** — clone them first.

delete.description: Permanently delete a custom profile. **Builtin profiles cannot be deleted.** The operation deletes all associated plugin entries.

post.description: Clone any profile (builtin or custom) into a new **Custom** profile. All plugin entries and config overrides are copied to the clone. The clone is fully editable. Use this to customise a builtin profile for a specific engagement.
Add a plugin to the profile with optional enable state, execution order, and config overrides. Idempotent — adding an already-present plugin returns 200. Requires edit permission on the profile.

patch.description: Update a plugin entry within a profile. Can change `is_enabled`, `execution_order`, or `config_override`. Use `is_enabled=false` to disable a plugin without removing it. `config_override` replaces the existing override entirely.

delete.description: Remove a plugin from the profile entirely. Use PATCH with `is_enabled=false` to disable without removing. Returns 404 if the plugin is not in this profile.

get.description:
Return API health status.

Returns:
    dict: Health status with version info.

ProfileType.title: ProfileType
ProfileType.description:
Classification of a scan profile.

Values:
    QUICK_RECON:          Fast passive intelligence gathering.
                          Plugins: DNS enum, WHOIS, Shodan, port discovery.
                          Duration: ~5 minutes.
    EXTERNAL_ASSESSMENT:  Comprehensive external perimeter assessment.
                          Plugins: full recon + vulnerability scanning.
                          Duration: ~2 hours.
    INFRASTRUCTURE:       Network-focused deep assessment.
                          Plugins: CIDR sweep, Nmap, CVE detection, SSL audit.
                          Duration: ~4 hours.
    WEB_ASSESSMENT:       Web application-focused assessment.
                          Plugins: Nikto, Nuclei web templates, header checks,
                          directory bruteforce.
                          Duration: ~2 hours.
    CUSTOM:               User-defined. No default plugins. Full control.

rule_type.description:
Matching strategy:
- **domain**: Exact FQDN match (e.g., `example.com`)
- **subdomain**: All subdomains of apex domain (e.g., rule `example.com` matches `api.example.com`)
- **cidr**: IPv4/IPv6 network range (e.g., `10.0.0.0/24`)
- **wildcard**: Glob pattern (e.g., `*.dev.example.com`)
- **host**: Single IP address (e.g., `192.168.1.100`)

disposition.description:
Whether this rule **allows** or **excludes** matching targets.
Exclusions always override allow rules (deny wins).

- cidr: CIDR notation (e.g., `10.0.0.0/24`)
- wildcard: glob pattern (e.g., `*.dev.example.com`)
- host: IP address (e.g., `192.168.1.100`)

ScopeRuleType.title: ScopeRuleType
ScopeRuleType.description:
Classification of a scope rule entry.

Values:
    DOMAIN:    Exact domain match — only this specific FQDN is in scope.
               Example: ``example.com`` matches ``example.com`` exactly;
               does NOT match ``sub.example.com``.
    SUBDOMAIN: All subdomains of a domain, but NOT the apex domain itself.
               Example: ``example.com`` matches ``api.example.com``,
               ``dev.api.example.com`` but NOT ``example.com``.
    CIDR:      IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR network range.
               Example: ``10.0.0.0/24`` matches any host in that range.
    WILDCARD:  Glob-style shell pattern (``fnmatch`` semantics).
               Example: ``*.dev.example.com``, ``api-*.example.com``.
    HOST:      Single IP address (no prefix). Exact match only.
               Example: ``192.168.1.100``.

    NO_SCOPE_DEFINED: No active scope rules exist for this workspace.
                   Scans are blocked until scope is configured.

UserRole.title: UserRole

    analyst: Can create scans, triage findings, and generate reports.
